thread:
Mia (PM): Quick rollcall — GA target next Tue. Need firm signoff on SLA wording, docs, support rota, monitoring alerts, and pricing bands. Who can confirm owners?
Arun (SRE): SLA draft is here, but we need an explicit exception for Private/Dedicated cross-region failover. Ping @Linh for perf caveats. :point_up:
Linh (Eng): Confirm — KV-cache cold-starts can spike p95 for first few minutes on new shards. Recommend SLA language: 'excludes transient warmup behavior within the first 10m after capacity changes' and add a canary bleed window.
Sophie (Support): Support rota: I sketched a 2-week 24/7 burn-in rota, then M-F 9–6 with on-call fallback. Will drop the rota link in #oncall in 10m. We should also prep canned replies for pilot customers. :memo:
Raj (Sales): Commercial ask: pilot customers want a guaranteed pilot pricing band + 30% capacity backstop. Propose a 'pilot pricing' section in the docs and a checkbox for sales signoff before provisioning.
Mia (PM): Good. Can each owner add one-line acceptance criteria we can check Friday? I'll own the final decision and release note.
Arun (SRE): Acceptance criteria (SLA/ops):
```
- SLA doc updated and reviewed by Security & Legal
- Exception matrix for Private/Dedicated included
- Canary bleed window configured (15m) and tested
- Automated SLA monitor firing to PagerDuty on >2 breaches/hr
```
Linh (Eng): Acceptance criteria (runtime):
```
- KV warmup mitigations in place (cache prefill + latency telemetry)
- Fallback model variant enabled for <100ms tail preservation
- Perf smoke run with 95/99 targets validated in staging
```
Sophie (Support): Acceptance criteria (support):
```
- Rota published with named backups
- Playbooks for common incidents (high p95, OOM, degraded throughput)
- Customer-facing KB updated for expected behavior and maintenance windows
```
Raj (Sales): Acceptance criteria (commercial):
```
- Pilot pricing documented with cap and backstop policy
- Sales commit checkbox added to provisioning flow
- Billing grace period (first 72h) for pilot migrations documented
```
Mia (PM): Monitoring owners — @Arun, can you confirm alerts and dashboards by EOD Thu? We need SLO dashboards per-customer slice + cost-per-token telemetry visible.
Arun (SRE): On it. I'll create dashboards and a runbook for escalations. deploy-bot will post smoke results.
deploy-bot: Smoke test scheduled for staging at 2024-06-10T18:00Z. Will post results.
Linh (Eng): One more: add a short note in SLA about scheduled maintenance windows and how they impact availability targets (standard 4h/month window). Keeps expectations clear.
Mia (PM): Perfect. Can we get a final thumbs-up thread Friday morning? If no major blockers, we'll mark GA readiness green and ship the docs + release notes. :white_check_mark:
Sophie (Support): 👍 will publish playbooks and canned replies by Thu EOD.
Raj (Sales): 👍 I'll update the provisioning flow and pipeline the pilot pricing docs.
Arun (SRE): 👍 dashboards + alerts queued, smoke results will be attached.
Linh (Eng): 👍 will add SLA exception wording and perf notes to the tech appendix.
Mia (PM): Thanks all — I'll collate and post the final checklist into this thread on Fri.
